name: Incline Bench Preacher Curl
research: Bench 60 deg (45 puts the pad top at z ~1.0, too low for a standing body without a deep squat). Pad: hinge (0,0.01,0.40), length 0.82 rising toward +Y; top surface plane through (0,-0.02,0.42) with normal n = (0,-0.87,0.5); top edge ~ (y 0.40, z 1.15). Athlete stands behind it (+Y side) facing -Y and leans in. Lean 30 (root rot X +30): shoulder = root + (0.22, -0.30, 0.37). Want shoulder joint over the top edge, 6 cm off the pad plane (arm radius): S = (0.22, 0.41, 1.29) -> root (0, 0.71, 0.92). Upper arm down the pad slope (0,-0.5,-0.87) world; torso-to-hips direction is (0,0.5,-0.87), so the angle between = 60 deg -> elev 60 / plane 88 (S2: 75 best, 60 close). Elbow = S + 0.29 slope = (0.22, 0.27, 1.04), normal distance to pad 0.06 m = resting on it. Elbow 20 -> 120 folding up (bend_world up): forearm ends ~60 deg above level toward -Y. Supinated axis [1,0,0]. Hip ~(0.11,0.66,0.90); ankles (+-0.15,0.88,0.074) behind the bench foot (y 0.72): hip-ankle 0.85 m -> knee bend ~38 deg, leaning into the pad. Right hand (no prop) rests ON the pad (fix 12 Nov: it floated 26 cm off the pad): right upper arm lies down the pad like the left (elev 60 / plane 88, elbow (-0.23,0.28,1.06), 6 cm off the pad face), forearm turned in 25 deg toward the midline so the fist (x -0.10, inside the 0.29 m pad) rests on the pad face (fist centre 4.3 cm off it); axis = thumb side = pad normal x forearm. highlight_side L: only the working arm is lit. S1 Oliveira 2009, S2 Moon 2013.
